_comment: yt-dlp 2026.10.26 error lines that cannot be produced by a local server. Each message is copied from the yt-dlp source file named in `source` (or, for `os`, the operating system's own error text) and composed the way ExtractorError formats it: 'ERROR: [extractor] id: message'. Captured runs live in runs/; these complement them and are not proof of live behaviour (SPEC §21.2).
